display.purpose: Page titles only: Slots, Familias, Ajustes.

label.purpose: Durations, paths, counts, column headers and chips; never below 11px.

section.purpose: Slot card names, settings section headings, stat numbers.

row.purpose: Shader names in the table and settings section titles.

small.purpose: Toast copy, settings descriptions, small buttons, path inputs.

shadows.name: preview-window

motion.name: toast-in

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action the view exists for: apply a shader.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D8FF00; color: #151500; border: 1px solid #D8FF00; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E4FF4D; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D8FF00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and settings actions; keeps the acid for the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #F1EFE8; border: 1px solid #262622; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #8A8A80; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D8FF00; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Type filter in the library toolbar; the active chip inverts to bone ink.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { background: #0D0D0C; color: #7C7C74; border: 1px solid #262622; border-radius: 0; padding: 5px 9px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #F1EFE8; border-color: #8A8A80; } .ds-chip-on { background: #F1EFE8; color: #0A0A0A; border-color: #F1EFE8; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Path and numeric inputs; square, mono, acid focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7C7C74; } .ds-input { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: #0D0D0C; border: 1px solid #262622; border-radius: 0; color: #F1EFE8; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #D8FF00; caret-color: #D8FF00; }

components.name: Selected Table Row
components.description: Selection is a full acid field with black type, not a tint or a side stripe.

components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr 118px 1fr 86px; align-items: center; gap: 0; height: 52px; padding: 0 26px; background: #D8FF00; color: #151500; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-row-idx { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-row-idx::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 5px; height: 5px; background: #151500; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: 1px; } .ds-row-name { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-row-type { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; } .ds-row-slot { font-size: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row-dur { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-align: right; }

components.name: Slot Card
components.description: One Umbriel destination: name, kind, current shader, timing and a change link.
components.css: .ds-slot { background: #111110; padding: 16px 18px 14px; min-height: 118px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-family: 'Archivo Narrow', sans-serif; color: #F1EFE8; } .ds-slot-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; } .ds-slot h3 { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 400; margin: 0; } .ds-slot-top span { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #7C7C74; } .ds-slot p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #D8FF00; } .ds-slot-foot { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #7C7C74; } .ds-slot-foot button { background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #262622; color: #F1EFE8; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Preview Window
components.description: The one lush surface: a window frame with acid corner brackets and a live shader canvas.
components.css: .ds-window { width: 360px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: #161615; border: 1px solid #3A3A33; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); } .ds-window::before, .ds-window::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 15px; height: 15px; border: 1px solid #D8FF00; } .ds-window::before { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 0; } .ds-window::after { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-left: 0; border-top: 0; } .ds-window-bar { height: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2C2C27; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 9px; } .ds-window-bar i { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3C3C35; } .ds-window-bar span { margin-left: auto; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #8A8A80; } .ds-window-screen { position: absolute; inset: 24px 0 0; background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 70% 20%, #1E3A2A 0%, #101A14 60%, #0A0A0A 100%); }

narrative.overview:
Umbriel Shaders looks like the printed running order of a demoscene party, repurposed as an instrument. Every shader is an entry with a number, a type, a destination and a duration; the timeline along the bottom is the page's spine. The interface is dense but quiet: one flat black field, hairline rules, and a single acid ink that only ever marks what is selected, live or actionable.

The system refuses two category defaults: the card-grid shader gallery and the dark-glass dashboard. There are no floating panels, no rounded tiles, no second accent, and no glow outside the preview. The shader preview is the one place where the product's subject — light moving on a surface — is allowed to be lush; everything around it stays printed, factual and legible.
keyCharacteristics: Flat black ground with 1px rules doing all the structural work.
One acid ink, reserved for selection, primary action and live state.
Condensed grotesk for names and controls; tabular mono for every number.
Zero radius and zero elevation; the only shadow belongs to the preview window.
A proportional running-order ruler that makes timing visible.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Acid is a field, not a tint. If it is not selected, primary or live, it does not get the acid.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from 1px rules and flat tonal steps. No card shadows, no glass, no gradient panels.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is mono, and the number that ends a row is right-aligned. Durations, counts, hashes and paths never use the display face.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: A page title stands alone. No eyebrow, no section number, no label above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a shadow only by depicting something physical. Panels, cards, menus and toasts stay flat.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: If a corner is rounded, it is not this system. Curves belong to the shader, not the chrome.

dos: Do invert a selected row, nav item or timeline segment completely (acid field, black type) instead of tinting it.
Do keep the ruler proportional to the real durations, and show the total in milliseconds.
Do keep every functional label at 11px or larger, even in the metadata tape and table headers.
Do put paths, durations, counts and curve names in the mono face.
Do let the shader preview be the only vivid surface in the window.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour; Warning Red is for destruction only.
Don't round corners, add drop shadows to panels, or use glass and blur as decoration.
Don't put an eyebrow or kicker above a page title.
Don't use gradients, glows or coloured halos outside the shader canvas.
Don't use acid for body copy, borders or headings; it is a field colour.
